To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed SLCV, a robust semi-automatic muscle fibre detection pipeline that is adaptable to different muscle fibre stains and is able to achieve high-quality muscle fibre detection results on fluorescence-stained images.
SLCV outperforms both SL- and CV-based methods in terms of cell count accuracy and area accuracy and yields very high quality muscle fibre detection results on a wide variety of images.

the supervised learning-computed vision combined strategy (SLCV) is able to detect muscle fibre cross-section in fluorescence-stained cross-section images, and that the combination of supervised learning and computer vision is superior in detecting muscle fibres compared to the best purely computer vision-based pipeline.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an accurate, robust, and user-friendly method that is applicable to a broad range of staining methods.
a novel approach for muscle fibre detection in images of muscle cross-sections.
a new method for automated muscle fibre CSA quantification in muscle cross-sectional images, which we have shown to be robust and highly accurate.

the SLCV pipeline is a robust and highly reliable method that can be used to accurately detect and delineate muscle fibres.
SLCV is a promising and robust method that can automatically detect muscle fibrous cross-sections with high sensitivity and Dice coefficient.
SLCV is a highly accurate and robust pipeline for automatic muscle fibre detection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SLCV is a fast and robust pipeline for muscle fibre segmentation in fluorescence-stained cross-sections.
SLCV is a fast and robust semi-automated muscle fibre detection pipeline, which is able to achieve very accurate fibre detection results.

we introduce a new pipeline that combines SL and CV to detect muscle fibres, which is adaptable to different stainings, is quickly and intuitvely tunable by the end user, and is able to detect muscle fibre CSA with high accuracy.

the SLCV pipeline is a powerful and versatile approach for muscle fibre detection in muscle cross-sections, which can easily be applied to different staining methods.

combining supervised learning with computer vision can be a promising strategy to improve muscle fibre detection in muscle fibre cross-sectional images, and that SLCV is an easy-to-use, robust pipeline for muscle fibre CSA determination.
